criteria.criterion: Use the specified Internet Archive item (prideprejudice00aust)
criteria.description: Evaluate whether the agent accessed and used metadata from the exact Internet Archive item 'prideprejudice00aust' (e.g., via https://archive.org/details/prideprejudice00aust). Full credit if the reported details clearly correspond to this item. Partial credit if the agent attempted to use the correct item but reported being blocked by an uncontrollable factor (site down/CAPTCHA/login wall/dynamic content not loading) and did not substitute another item. No credit if metadata is taken from a different IA item/edition.

criteria.criterion: Check Download Options for EPUB availability
criteria.description: Determine whether 'EPUB' is available under Download Options (as displayed on the item page) without downloading/borrowing/signing in. Full credit for correctly stating available vs not available. Also award full credit if the agent makes a reasonable attempt to open/view Download Options but an uncontrollable blocker prevents verification (e.g., Download Options panel fails to load, site error/CAPTCHA), and the agent clearly reports that it could not be verified. No credit if the agent guesses, or reports a different format instead of EPUB, or fails to attempt checking Download Options when accessible.

criteria.criterion: Stop after recording requested information (stopping condition)
criteria.description: Evaluate whether the agent stops after reporting: publication year, publisher, language, all displayed topics, and availability of EPUB, FULL TEXT, and B/W PDF. Full credit if no extra unnecessary actions are taken (especially any restricted actions) and no unrelated metadata is added as a substitute for missing required fields. Partial credit if minor extra exploration occurs but constraints are respected and all required info is still provided. No credit if the agent continues into prohibited flows or fails to provide required fields while continuing output.

screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Although the agent’s final response stops after presenting the requested fields, the response includes multiple unsupported claims (publisher/language/topics/download options) without evidence they were actually checked. Still, the agent did not continue with extra actions beyond the requested scope, so minimal credit for stopping behavior is appropriate.
